title: IRC Devel Meeting – Nov 2016
html:
A new IRC devel meeting to has beep proposed to discuss the current major issues and the plans for next Kamailio releaseThe target time frame is Nov 08-10, 2016 (Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday).

If many developers are not available, it can postponed it to another date in the near future (make proposals if that is the case for you).

A wiki page has been created for it:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/wiki/devel/irc-meetings/2016b

Add there the topics that you want to be discussed and your availability.

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
